subject: Supplier setup: PO flow, DPA signature & subprocessor list needed
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliosense.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliosense.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting set up with Redwood (PO / security docs)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re moving quickly on procurement and I wanted to confirm next steps so we can get a PO out and start the onboarding checklist. A few specific asks from our side so we can route internally: 

- Can you share the latest DPA we need to sign (and confirm if it supports EU SCCs)?
- Do you have a current SOC 2 report we can review (link or PDF)?
- We also need a subprocessor list for our security team to vet.
- What is the billing contact and PO process (invoices to AP contact)?

Goal: have a PO issued by 6/11. Can you point me to the docs or attach them?

Appreciate it — Samira

Samira Khan | Procurement Lead
HelioSense Inc.
Attachments: (none)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliosense.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting set up with Redwood (PO / security docs)

Samira —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (Legal) and Vivek (Finance/Procurement) so we can get everything routed. Quick plan: 

1) I’ve attached our current DPA (Redwood-DPA-v3.pdf) — it includes SCCs in section 6, and Laura can confirm the language.
2) SOC 2 report: I’ll share a secure link to the auditor-hosted file; you’ll receive it via separate drive link because of access controls.
3) Subprocessor list: request sent to Applied ML team; they’ll confirm the CSV (expected tomorrow).
4) PO / invoicing: Vivek — can you confirm billing address and the invoice routing steps for HelioSense?

Next steps for HelioSense: confirm whether DPA redlines are needed (we can do DocuSign or mark changes), and provide your AP contact + preferred PO template if you have one. If you don’t have a template, I’ll attach ours (PO-template-Redwood.xlsx).

We’ll aim to have the SOC2 link and subprocessor file to you by EOD 6/3.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-DPA-v3.pdf, PO-template-Redwood.xlsx
From: HelioSense Procurement <procurement@heliosense.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliosense.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting set up with Redwood (PO / security docs)

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick response. A few notes from our security and AP teams after an initial review: 

- Security asked for the SOC 2 report link and the subprocessor CSV. We received the SOC2 link you sent (thank you), and we downloaded the auditor-hosted PDF.
- Attached is our completed supplier intake form (not attached here to keep thread short) and our AP contact for PO routing: ap-team@heliosense.com. Please direct invoices to: HelioSense, Attn: Accounts Payable, 1200 Harbor Blvd, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401.
- Our security team had one DPA question: do you allow customer-requested restriction on processing in certain regions? They asked whether we can opt to restrict non-US processing by flagging it in the contract.

Also attaching the subprocessor list we maintain on our side (subprocessors-2026-06-03.csv) — this is for our records only, not required by you.

Samira (cc) — please confirm whether we need to propose any redlines for your DPA.

Best,
HelioSense Procurement (on behalf of Samira Khan)
Attachments: subprocessors-2026-06-03.csv
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliosense.com>, procurement@heliosense.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting set up with Redwood (PO / security docs)

Samira / team —

Thanks — confirm receipt of the SOC2 link and your AP details. A few actions from our side to keep the timeline: 

- Laura (Legal) reviewed our DPA and confirms we can accommodate a region-processing restriction via a one-paragraph addendum; Laura, I’m going to send a tracked-change DPA and a DocuSign envelope if that path is preferred.
- Vivek, can you provision a one-time waiver so we can accept the HelioSense PO terms on net-30? If not, let us know the preferred invoicing cadence.
- Rishi (Security) — quick FYI: HelioSense shared an internal subprocessors CSV; please add to vendor profile and confirm no red flags by EOD 6/7.

Samira — attached: the DPA with comments (Redwood-DPA-v3.pdf, version with comment highlights) and a DocuSign envelope link for signature. If you prefer to negotiate redlines, Laura will take the lead and we can schedule a 30-min call this week. Otherwise, sign via DocuSign and we’ll issue the PO.

DocuSign (envelope): https://www.docusign.com/signer?envelopeId=E-123456789
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRedwoodVendorDocs

Next milestone: PO issued by HelioSense and signed DPA in place — target 6/11. Let me know if anything blocks that date.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Redwood-DPA-v3.pdf (with comments), SOC2-report-2025.pdf (linked), PO-template-Redwood.xlsx
